title: Planar: faceInteriorPoint returns a point already proven OUTSIDE the face (wrong fill for sliver faces)
description: packages/core/src/engine/planar/query.ts:113: centroid tested at :92; if it fails, a 16x16 grid over the bbox is scanned (:106-112); if that also finds nothing it returns {x:cx,y:cy} — the same centroid already proven outside via inside(...) at :92. For a thin/acute sliver face (which merge crossings genuinely produce), 256 grid samples can all miss and the returned outside point is fed to assignFaceFillsBySampling (build.ts:103 -> pointInPolygon can match a DIFFERENT region containing that point -> wrong fill) and faceKey/resolveFace/pickInRect (subselection.ts -> wrong/unstable selection key). Every caller already handles a null return safely, so returning the known-bad point is strictly worse. Fix: return null when neither centroid nor grid yields an interior point (optionally after a denser adaptive scan). Add a test building an acute sliver face asserting fill classification. Confidence: confirmed logic error (product impact needs-repro).
